title: Cosmic Wanderer and Trinity
description: A surreal black and white line illustration shows a large cosmic figure with three faces and multiple eyes hovering in a starry black sky filled with geometric shapes and clouds. Below, a backpacked traveler walks across a curved landscape of pink and red planetary rings, holding up a small glowing jar containing a tiny creature.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene in black and white line art with selective pink and red accents. A giant three-faced figure with multiple eyes and geometric patterns floats in a starry black sky amid clouds, floating triangles, and celestial symbols. Below, a backpacked human traveler walks on a curved planetary surface with pink and red rings, holding up a glowing jar containing a small creature, surrounded by stylized alien plants.
